display_name: The whole Cat Act 2011 (WA) and the whole Cat Regulations 2012 — registration, microchipping, sterilisation, transfer, facilities, breeding, enforcement, subsidiary legislation — as in force from 25 September 2025, an independent reading
edition_encoded: Cat Act 2011 (WA), Act No. 55 of 2011, consolidation 00-l0-01 (current from 25 Sep 2025); Cat Regulations 2012, consolidation 02-b0-00 (current from 24 Jul 2025). Both fetched 2026-10-05 from legislation.wa.gov.au; sha256 in inputs/PROVENANCE.md.
scope: The whole Act: Parts 1-7, ss 1-88 (s 48 deleted). The whole of the Cat Regulations 2012: regs 1-30 and Schedules 1-3 (Sch 2 modified penalties and Sch 3 fees encoded row by row; Sch 1 forms inert). Every provision has a row in the NOTES.md coverage table and none is deferred. Time is reckoned under the Interpretation Act 1984 ss 61-62; 'working day' takes its ordinary meaning (fork F-01). The law is stated as in force from 25 September 2025, and every decision refuses for an earlier date. NOT encoded: the Cat (Uniform Local Provisions) Regulations 2013 (read only to confirm what they prescribe under the Act), local laws, the Cat Amendment (Local Laws) Bill 2026, and the other Acts the Cat Act refers to, whose determinations are inputs.
independence: Written from the sources only. The other encodings of this Act in canon (../legalese-michael/, ../../../cat-act-2011-lqa/) were not opened, apart from one source file in the latter (the Evidence Act 2025 as passed). See NOTES.md section 1.

checks.note: `l4 run` exits 0 even when an assertion fails; check.sh reads the diagnostics. No assertion is expected to fail.

not_reviewed.note: No one who knows Western Australian local-government or animal-control law has read this encoding against the Act and Regulations. No independent test pass (a second session writing expectations before reading the encoding) has been run yet. Six questions for a domain expert are in NOTES.md section 6.

forks.F-01: 'working day' (ss 32, 34): ordinary meaning — not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday in the input list. The Local Government Act 1995 defines it only for one Schedule.
forks.F-02: 'within the previous 3 years' / 'within the 12 months before': an event on the anniversary is outside.
forks.F-03: reg 12(2)(a)(i): a one-year registration taking effect on 31 October runs to the following 31 October.
forks.F-04: reg 12(2)(a)(ii): a 3-year registration ends on the third 31 October (registration years), not 31 October of the calendar year of the third anniversary. Open question 2.
forks.F-05: s 4(1)(c): a child keeper and the child's parent or guardian are both owners.
forks.F-06: s 5(2)(a): days kept counted from the start of keeping, start day excluded; a non-keeping owner takes the earliest current keeper's start.
forks.F-07: 'an offence against this Act' excludes offences against regulations and local laws made under it (Interpretation Act s 5; Cat Act ss 62(1), 77(5)).
forks.F-08: The 3-year conviction window is counted back from the day the application is determined.
forks.F-09: s 9(2)(c)-(d) carry no age limit: a kitten under 6 months that is unchipped or entire must be refused registration. Open question 1.
forks.F-10: Sch 3 item 1(a) 'after 31 May' means June to October.
forks.F-11: Sch 3 cl 1(3): the applicant's pensioner status is the owner's.
forks.F-12: reg 19: a foster carer is not 'an organisation or person set out in regulation 9'.
forks.F-13: s 37: refuse to consider, then 'is not to refuse' (s 37(5), reg 23), then reg 22(2) deferral, then 'may refuse', then grant.
forks.F-14: s 38: the s 37(2) things are tested on the day of cancellation.
forks.F-15: reg 22(1): the infringement notice must have been issued within the 12 months; payment date not tested.
forks.F-16: s 71(1)(a): the right to apply for review arises when notice of the decision is given.
